en.name: Innocent VIII
en.summary: A weak, financially troubled pope remembered chiefly for the 1484 bull that helped ignite the era's witch-hunting panic.
en.body: Giovanni Battista Cybo governed largely under the influence of stronger cardinals, most notably his eventual successor Rodrigo Borgia, and struggled with chronic debt that led to selling church offices and titles. His 1484 bull Summis desiderantes affectibus lent papal authority to the pursuit of witchcraft, later prefixed to the notorious witch-hunting manual the Malleus Maleficarum, giving him an outsized and troubling historical legacy relative to his otherwise undistinguished reign.
